{{Quote|Karl, my son, how could he let this happen? I should have seen his gambling problem sooner.|[[Hugo Eckener/Legends|Hugo Eckener]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:GSwHE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Go Speak with Hugo Eckener|Naboo}}</ref>}}
'''Karl Eckener''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Karl was the son of [[Hugo Eckener/Legends|Hugo Eckener]] and a [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Please, rescue my son, Karl. Don't let anything happen to him.|Hugo Eckener, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RKE" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Karl Eckener ran up huge gambling debts to both the [[Skaak Tippers]] and the [[Darkwalkers|Darkwalker]] criminal groups. He was finally kidnapped and his father was forced to work to pay off Karl's gambling debts. Nevertheless, Karl Eckener was never freed by the criminals.<ref name="SWG:EHB" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Hugo Eckener was forced to request [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|RSF]] agents to [[Rescue of Karl Eckener|assault]] the [[Darkwalker Cave (Theed)|Darkwalker Cave]] to liberate his son.<ref name="SWG:RKE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Karl Eckener appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RKE" /> prior to the game's closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Karl Eckener was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
